description:
Attach implementation evidence to a post (shown publicly).

        kind is one of branch|commit|pr|transcript|url; ref is the branch
        name, commit sha, or URL. Voters see these in the post page's
        "Implementation" section.

action_key.description: Optional key identifying the agent action this evidence belongs to.
action_key.title: Action Key

kind.description: Kind of evidence: one of branch, commit, pr, transcript or url.
kind.title: Kind

label.description: Short label shown with the evidence.
label.title: Label

ref.description: The evidence reference itself: branch name, commit hash, PR reference, transcript id or URL, according to kind.
ref.title: Ref

slug.description: Slug of the board (its URL path segment).
slug.title: Slug

name: add_evidence
